method: exact polynomial coefficient identity and symbolic scalar inversion argument, no numerical sampling
boundary: For |z|=1, z!=0; g(z)=(1/z) f1(z), so distance 0.
centre: f1(0)=0 and g(0)=e1; span={0} and norm(e1)=1 for every usual ell-p norm.
all_N: Embed e1 in every C^N, N>=1; one generator suffices, extra generators may be zero.
certificate_status: Reconstruction of an already-public negative answer, not a discovery candidate.
